title: General Data Protection Regulation — Statute profile
subject: General Data Protection Regulation
summary: General Data Protection Regulation is a regulation of European Union enacted in 2016, in the area of data privacy. EU privacy regulation giving individuals control over personal data, effective 25 May 2018. It is formally cited as Regulation (EU) 2016/679.
key_points: Core effect: EU privacy regulation giving individuals control over personal data, effective 25 May 2018.
Status: landmark regulation of European Union.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
